subject: angol
title: Work, careers and the future
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a pályaválasztásról, a munkatapasztalatról és a munka világának változásairól kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, indokold a véleményedet, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: What job would you like to be doing in ten years' time, and why?
Which is more important when choosing a career: passion or a good salary?
Have you had any work experience? What did you learn from it?
How did your parents choose their careers? Has this influenced you?
Which jobs do you think will disappear in the next twenty years? Why?
Would you like to work from home? What would be the advantages and disadvantages?
Is it a good idea for students to work while they are studying? Why or why not?
Would you consider working abroad? What would attract you?
Why do you think some young people find it hard to get their first job?
What does a good work-life balance mean to you?

usefulPhrases.hu: egészséges egyensúly a munka és a magánélet között

usefulPhrases.en: Ideally, I'd like a job that ...
usefulPhrases.hu: Ideális esetben olyan munkát szeretnék, amely ...

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What job would you like to be doing in ten years' time, and why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Ideally, I'd like to be working as a physiotherapist, maybe at a sports clinic. I've played volleyball for years and had a couple of injuries, so I've seen how much a good physio can help. I like the idea of a job where you can actually see the results of your work.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Which is more important when choosing a career: passion or a good salary?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: For me, it's definitely passion, although of course the salary has to be enough to live on.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Because you spend around forty years of your life working, and doing something you don't enjoy for that long must be miserable. Besides, people who love their job tend to be better at it, so they often end up earning more anyway.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Have you had any work experience? What did you learn from it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, last summer I worked at a restaurant by Lake Balaton for six weeks. It was exhausting, but I learnt how to stay polite with rude customers and how to work under pressure. It also made me appreciate how hard my parents work.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Would you like to work from home? What would be the advantages and disadvantages?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Maybe a couple of days a week, but not all the time. The advantages are obvious: no commuting and more flexibility. On the downside, I think I'd miss my colleagues, and it must be hard to switch off when your office is also your bedroom.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: minden válasz indokolt és személyes (röplabdás sérülések, nyári munka a Balatonnál), a pénz vagy szenvedély kérdésére pedig világos álláspontot fogalmaz meg, és a visszakérdezés után két érvvel támasztja alá.

Nyelvhelyesség: változatos szerkezetek hibátlanul – folyamatos főnévi igenév (I'd like to be working), Present Perfect (I've played, I've seen), a következtetést kifejező 'must be' és az 'end up + -ing'.
Szókincs: a munka világának pontos kifejezései (work under pressure, commuting, flexibility, colleagues) és természetes kötőszavak (Besides, On the downside).
Érdemes megtanulni: „enough to live on”, „they often end up earning more”, „It also made me appreciate …”, „it must be hard to switch off”.
